"P/N: 5816A0474000" and "P/N: 5816A0475000" are printed on the stickers on the modules. :"CK77 94V-0" is silkscreened on the wireless modules. The AP is essentially identical to the [[Aerohive HiveAP 330]] besides the antenna configuration :(330 = integral antennas, 350 = external antennas connected via RP-SMA). ;Per the FCC manual / QSG... *The default SSID pattern is '''AH-XXXXXX_ac''' ('''XXXXXX''' being the last three octets :of the wireless interface MAC address [lower case letters]). :The default PSK is specified as '''aerohive'''. *The default login (telnet [''note that the Telnet connection is protected by the WPA2 security''] / SSH) :credentials appear to be '''admin:aerohive'''. The default IP address ''may'' be ''1.1.1.1''. Per '''WiGLE''', this device may use 08:EA:44 and/or 40:18:B1 OUIs. ===Hardware specification=== *CPU: ''[[Freescale]]'' P1020 Dual-core ''PowerPC'' (@533MHz) *Memory: 256MB (SDRAM) DDR2 *Storage: 64MB NOR Flash *Network: 2x Gigabit Ethernet ports *WiFi: 2x [[Atheros]] AR9390 (3T3R 802.11abgn) *USB: 1x USB 2.0 ports *Power: 12V, 2A via barrel or 802.3af via eth0 ==Links of Interest== :[https://docs.aerohive.com/330000/docs/help/english/6.6r1/hm/full/Content/hw/ap/AP330_AP350.htm Product Documentation] ==Flashing== {{Flashnotice}} ===Flashing OpenWrt=== {{OpenWrt |techdata = https://openwrt.org/toh/hwdata/aerohive/aerohive_hiveap-350 |wikipage = |forumpage = |github = |target = mpc85xx |subtarget = p1020 |arch = powerpc_8548 |support_commit_id = f2b7d9dc1ca3d33f14961cf2885639f4f9e8965e |support_started_version = 18.06.0 |current_supported_version = |last_supported_version = |image_too_big = |unsupportedfuncntions = |lan_hardware = |lan_comment = |wlan_hardware = 2x Atheros AR9390 (mini-PCIe) |wlan_comment = |usb_sata_comment = |inst_method = U-Boot TFTP + serial recovery, see git-commit |inst_comment = |rec_method = U-Boot TFTP + serial recovery |rec_comment = |comment = This device is identical to the Aerohive HiveAP-330 besides the antenna configuration }} {{SCollapse | git • >> | 
mpc85xx: Add Aerohive HiveAP-330 Access Point
The following adds the Aerohive HiveAP-330 Access Point to LEDE under
the mpc85xx/p1020 subtarget.

Hardware:
- SoC: Freescale P1020NSE2DFB
- NAND: Intel JS28F512M29EWH 64MB
- Memory: 2x ProMOS V59C1G01168QBJ3 128MB (Total of 256MB)
- 2.4GHz WiFi: Atheros AR9390-AL1A
- 5.0GHz WiFi: Atheros AR9390-AL1A
- Eth1: Atheros AR8035-A PoE
- Eth2: Atheros AR8035-A
- TPM: Atmel AT97SC3204
- LED Driver: TI LP5521

Flashing:
1. Hook into UART (9600 baud) and enter U-Boot. You may need to enter a
password of administrator or AhNf?d@ta06 if prompted.
2. Once in U-Boot, tftp boot the initramfs image:
    dhcp;
    tftpboot 0x1000000 192.168.1.101:lede-
mpc85xx-p1020-hiveap-330-initramfs.zImage;
    tftpboot 0x6000000 192.168.1.101:lede-mpc85xx-p1020-hiveap-330.fdt;
    bootm 0x1000000 - 0x6000000;
3. Once booted, scp over the sysupgrade file and sysupgrade the device
to flash LEDE to the NAND.
    sysupgrade /tmp/lede-mpc85xx-p1020-hiveap-330-sysupgrade.img

Signed-off-by: Chris Blake
